pull.label: Pull the Handle v2
pull.blurb: 2-to-6-leg independent tickets off the full board
pull.paused: Paused while the picker is rebuilt: its legs hit about 52% against the 55-58% a pick'em slip needs. The record keeps running in shadow.

single.label: The Single
single.blurb: one high-conviction selection, when there is one
single.plain: This product has made 6 picks since 2026-09-17. About 83 out of every 100 won. That has been enough to stay ahead so far.

provenance.note: 52 early picks were re-attributed on 2026-09-03 by matching them to the picker artifact that recorded them. Their source had named the module that wrote the row, not the picker. Picker records before that date changed as a result; the underlying ledger did not.
